rationale: The agent did some due diligence (looked up the user by name and ZIP, retrieved user and order details), but it executed a write action (modify_pending_order_items) without first confirming the exact upgrades or payment method with the user, which violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. It also only upgraded items in one pending order (#W9911714) despite the user asking to upgrade all items, with no clarification or confirmation about scope or why other orders weren't addressed. The agent asserted that the price difference was covered by the gift card without presenting tool evidence of balance sufficiency, and it did not verify or confirm the shoe size constraint with the user. These issues fail the pass bar.
